captions.extension-summary-likelihoods: Posterior summaries under Gaussian and native multivariate Student-t4 errors for 31 constructed pairs of estimates. The second supplied estimate is fixed at 0.5. Both likelihoods have error covariance 0.5 I2; the Student-t scale matrix is 0.25 I2. A single fixed Gaussian prior has variances one and correlation 0.6. Panels show the posterior mean and standard deviation in condition 1. No prior weights are estimated in this illustration.
captions.extension-regression-responses: Conditional response summaries from four separate constructed datasets, each with eight observations and one predictor. Lines average transformed posterior draws; shaded regions are 95% equal-tail credible intervals for conditional means, binomial probability or survival, not future observations. Open circles show Gaussian outcomes, observed binomial fractions with eight trials, and Poisson counts with exposure two. Gaussian residual SD is 0.4. Weibull shape is fixed at 1.3; curves share the same time axis and use x=-1, 0 and 1. The upper rug marks five event times with ticks and three right-censoring times with plus signs. Fits use one Gaussian coefficient-prior component, intercept SD five, two chains, 300 warmup iterations and 500 retained draws per chain. These examples illustrate interfaces and do not measure calibration.

alt_text.extension-summary-likelihoods: Two line plots compare posterior means and posterior standard deviations for condition 1 as its supplied estimate varies; condition 2 is held fixed. Solid blue denotes Gaussian errors and dashed orange denotes Student-t4 errors.
alt_text.extension-regression-responses: Four panels show Gaussian, binomial and Poisson conditional response curves with raw observations, followed by Weibull survival curves at three predictor values. Shaded credible bands describe conditional means or survival; a time rug distinguishes events and right censoring.
